spec_rumor_note: Viral claims citing Ryzen 5 5600X + RTX 3060 + 16 GB RAM or RTX 5070 for 60 FPS gameplay are unverified speculation; no playable gameplay benchmarks exist yet.

build_requirements.requirement: Windows 10/11 (64-bit) or Linux (64-bit with Proton for runtime)
Python 3.12+ (standard library tools run with python -I)
LunarG Vulkan SDK (includes spirv-val for shader validation)
LLVM with AMDGPU target (LLVM 23.1.x used in upstream shader translation runs)
Visual Studio 2022 (Desktop development with C++) + CMake on Windows
Git with submodule support (git clone --recursive / git submodule update --init)
